description: Check and clean phone numbers before you save, call or send SMS: is the number valid for its country, the E.164, international and national format, country, line type (mobile, fixed line, toll free, VoIP), area and time zone. One number or a list of up to 200. Works from the public numbering plans, runs on our server in milliseconds. It does not look up who owns a number. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.001 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/phone-number-validator.
